report_discrepancies.note: General Fund budget schedule: printed total disbursements 8,745,616 is 1 more than its lines add up to (8,745,615); combining schedule on p5 prints 8,611,738 for the same lines, which are 1 more than the sum (8,611,737). Rounding.

decision_needed.question: The Cooperative Fund shows 5,504 of 'General Fund support (as expensed in the General Fund)' as a receipt. Is this a transfer (money counted as both General Fund spending and cooperative receipt)?

notes: Modified cash basis school district; basis recorded as cash. Governmental funds Total column used (p3, receipts and disbursements; p4 beginning/ending fund balance, total roll-forward 4,513,116 + 10,817,556 - 9,922,138 = 5,408,534 with net interfund transfers zero in the total column). The p4 statement header prints 'year ended August 31, 2024' but its figures are 2025 (typo in the report). School Nutrition fund is governmental here (not an enterprise fund). Receipt lines 'Other local receipts', 'Nonrevenue receipts' and 'Other' were split using the General Fund schedule and fund schedules on pp6-7, 12-14, 16 where the report shows the components. County and ESU sources split only for the General Fund 2110 Fines and license fees (p6, fines and forfeitures); the rest and State receipts kept as printed groups. Balance sheet from the Statement of Activities and Net Position (p2): cash only, no liabilities. Detail: the General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (pp6-8) is recorded instead of the General Fund Components combining schedule (p5), which is not double counted; its Depreciation and Employee Benefit columns are recorded from their own fund schedules (pp9-10). Hidden transfer: the p5 reclassifications column removes 500,000 of General Fund spending (Instruction 150,000, Operation and maintenance 150,000, Transportation 200,000) as transfer to the Depreciation Fund (500,000 General Fund support); recorded as contra spending lines and an other financing line in detail. Transfers cross-check: General Fund transfers 133,878 = Nutrition 87,528 + Activities 46,350; net of all transfers is zero. Employee Benefit Fund has no 2025 disbursements. General Fund spending lines have no object breakdown (not itemized); the General Fund Operational Expenses exhibit is not in the trimmed PDF. Read pages 1-16 of 16.
